what: bậc xuống bãi tắm: a piece of 2 m of the flight of granite steps from the walk of the sea down to the sand of Bãi Trước (the steps run along the wall)
uses: Plan 0026, R10, Q11: in the openings of the low wall of the beach (wall_openings of the showcase) and along the sections where the flight of steps runs along the wall (photo 0): the game puts the pieces one after another along the line, the port end of a piece on the port start of the next, the top edge (the origin) at the edge of the walk, the steps down to +y. Their places: Check (the photos do not give them all).

sources.author: Ted McGrath (time-to-look, Flickr)
sources.shows: Bãi Trước at low tide, a crop of the original: the low wall with its rail and openings on a wall of granite blocks in courses, a band at the level of the walk, and under it a long flight of seven steps of granite down to the sand along the wall; a woman in a nón lá and a man in blue with a crate on the steps; painted fishing boats on the sand.

sources.author: Nguyen tan dat Dat (tandat.2301, Flickr)
sources.shows: The north part of Bãi Trước from the sand (a crop of the original): wide flights of granite steps from the walk down to the sand and the water between the sections of the low wall, seen from the side; on the right a section of the low wall on a footing of concrete, with a short flight of three steps at its end; swim rings, people on the sand.

sources.author: Huy Đi Lang Thang (YouTube)
sources.shows: A walk on the sand of Bãi Trước on a calm morning (the video is 14:37; this picture is the third automatic picture of YouTube, at about 11:00): eight courses of granite blocks step down from the walk to the sand, next to the end of a section whose wall of blocks leans back, with the low wall and its openings on top; palms and light blue lamp poles.

sources.author: Trường Hà / VnExpress
sources.shows: The south part of the beach full of swimmers at the end of the afternoon: the low wall with its rail and openings in sections on a sloped face of stone, a stair down to the sand in a gap between two sections, swim rings, light blue lamp poles behind the palms.

sources.author: Huy Đi Lang Thang (YouTube)
sources.shows: A walk along the north part of the walk of Bãi Trước (the video is 4:19; this picture is the second automatic picture of YouTube, at about 2:10): the end of a section of the low wall of granite blocks with its rail and narrow openings, and in the gap to the next section a flight of steps down to the sand.

length.source: A piece of the row: I choose 2 m. Photo 0: the flight runs along the wall for more than 30 m; photo 1: flights in the gaps between the sections.

steps.source: Photo 0 (2019-01-24): seven steps of 19 px of the crop under a drop of 0.35 m from the walk, at the scale of the man in blue on the steps (192 px for 1.6 m): a drop of 1.43 m in all. Photo 2 (2020): eight courses of blocks from the sand to the walk. Photos 1, 3 and 4 show flights in the gaps (Q11: five photos of 2017 to 2021).

step_rise.source: The drop of 1.43 m (photo 0) over eight steps: 0.18 m; photo 2: each course of blocks is about a block high.

tread.source: Photo 1: the flights at the left, seen from the side: each tread is about 1.5 times a riser: 0.27 m; 0.3 m.

block.source: Photo 2: the blocks of the steps are about two times as long as they are high: 0.35 m.

colors.value: granite #9a958b, the low steps darker #7b766d, joints #66625b
colors.source: Photos 0 and 2: grey granite blocks, darker on the low steps by the sand.

looks.seen: Next to photos 0 to 4: eight steps of 0.18 m by 0.3 m from the edge of the walk down to the sand, as the flight along the wall in photo 0 and the courses of blocks in photo 2; the mass under the last tread is under the sand in the game. The darker low steps hardly show; the joints of the blocks are at the near level only.
